title: Extension of a local finite free map from an ideal lattice
statement: Let Z be integral Noetherian and G coherent [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-pc-integral-scheme, pqf-def-coherent]. Fix r ≥ 0, an open U containing the generic point ξ, and a map φ from the restriction of the finite free structure-module sheaf on ULift (Fin r) to G restricted to U. Suppose the stalk of φ at ξ in U is invertible [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. There exist a coherent ideal sheaf I on Z and χ from the coproduct of r copies of I.toModules to G whose stalk at ξ in Z is invertible [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

proof.text: Construct J as the vanishing ideal of Z minus U. The reduced induced closed subscheme theorem and the affine ideal-zero-set criterion identify the open where the ideal stalk is the unit ideal with U.

The finite free source E is coherent and G is quasi-coherent by the locally Noetherian criterion. Use the final extension clause of coherent_homs_over_open to extend φ from J^n E, with the restriction identity in that theorem.

Use the affine product formula to construct I with sections J(W)^n and identify J^n E with I to the finite direct sum power. The coordinate maps commute with localization, hence glue. For n = 0 take the unit ideal. Powers are quasi-coherent; their inclusion in the coherent structure module makes them coherent by the quasi-coherent submodule clause.

Transport the extension along that sum isomorphism to obtain χ. On U the ideal-power inclusion is invertible. Taking the generic stalk of the extension identity and conjugating by restriction-stalk isomorphisms identifies χ_ξ with φ_ξ composed with isomorphisms, proving invertibility, also for r = 0.

theorem exists_generic_ideal_extension (Z : Scheme.{w}) [IsNoetherian Z]
    [IsIntegral Z] (G : Z.Modules)
    (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace G)
    (r : ℕ) (U : Z.Opens) (hx : genericPoint Z ∈ U)
    (φ : (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj
        (SheafOfModules.free (R := Z.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{w} (Fin r))) ⟶
      (restrictFunctor U.ι).obj G)
    (hφ : IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor U.toScheme.toRingedSpace
      (⟨genericPoint Z, hx⟩ : U.toScheme)).map φ)) :
    ∃ (I : Z.IdealSheafData),
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent Z.toRingedSpace I.toModules ∧
      ∃ (χ : (∐ fun _ : Fin r => I.toModules) ⟶ G),
        IsIso ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Z.toRingedSpace
          (genericPoint Z)).map χ)
